scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Patent Registration
other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual or legal entity involved in innovation and product/process development.
Patent must be registered within the policy period (August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025).
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of publication/notification of the patent.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 75% reimbursement of patent registration expenses, capped at ₹25,00,000 per applicant, with attorney fee caps of ₹50,000 domestic and ₹2,00,000 per country internationally.
